concerns.text: Task T051 (unit test) is listed without a dependency on its producer task T050 (download script). This creates a consumer‑before‑producer ordering violation.

Task T100 (end‑to‑end integration test) depends on tasks T013, T015, T024, and T061, which are defined in later phases (User Story 1, User Story 2, and User Story 3). This violates the producer‑before‑consumer rule.
Task T024 (US 2) lists a dependency on T038b, which belongs to User Story 1. Cross‑story dependencies break the requirement that each user‑story block be independently implementable and testable.
Task T034 (US 3) depends on T016 from User Story 1, creating a cross‑story ordering violation and preventing US 3 from being shipped independently.
Task T049 (US 3) depends on T024 and T025 from User Story 2, further entangling user‑story boundaries and violating the independent‑shippability principle.
